select fp.finprod_id finprodId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, fp.finprod_type finprodType, fp.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt, DATE_FORMAT(fp.vdate, '%Y-%m-%d') vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(fp.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d') mdate1, fccr.basis basis , fccr.CALC_TYPE intType, fccr.CALC_TYPE intTypeCode, (fccr.yield)*100 rate from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join (select * from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr where 1 = 1 and fccr.eff_date = (select max(a.eff_date) from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE a where a.finprod_id = fccr.finprod_id and a.finprod_type = a.finprod_type)) fccr on fp.finprod_id = fccr.finprod_id and fp.finprod_type = fccr.finprod_type and fccr.branch = 0 inner JOIN (SELECT A.FINPROD_ID, MAX(A.EFF_DATE) effDate FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE A
WHERE A.EFF_DATE <=STR_TO_DATE('9999-12-31','%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY A.FINPROD_ID) crd on fccr. finprod_id=crd.FINPROD_ID and fccr.eff_date=crd.effDate left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id where 1=1 and fp.finprod_type=#{finprodType}
AND fp.finprod_id in
#{item}
AND (fp.finprod_id like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%'))
AND fp.vdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND fp.vdate <=STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND fp.mdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND fp.mdate <=STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')

select finprod_id as id, finprod_name as text from FIN_PRODUCT WHERE 1 = 1 and FINPROD_TYPE = 'F07'
AND ( finprod_id like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR finprod_name like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') )
GROUP BY finprod_id, finprod_name
